title: When Day Breaks
description: This is the simplest resource pack that replaces the Sun and Moon with analogues inspired by SCP-001 - "When Day Breaks". The sunflower flower was also replaced to match.
body:
# **DESCRIPTION**
This resource pack replaces the vanilla Sun, Moon, and sunflower flower with **blood-red** counterparts inspired by the object **SCP-001 "_When Day Breaks_"**.
It's great for role-playing and special modpacks!

### **Recommendations**
It is highly recommended to use with the [**_SCP-001, When Day Breaks_**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/scp-001-when-day-breaks) mod created by _Zcoper_!
They match perfectly and he was literally created for him.

### **Requirements**
_Minecraft Java Edition 1.20.1_

### **P.S**
_The textures are not mine, I did not draw them, I just repainted them in the right color, no more._
